title: Angry Squire and Boomer's, playing in the club window
summary: With Cedar Walton and Billy Higgins at the Angry Squire, and with Bobby Timmons at Boomer's, they are made to play in windows until bandstands are built.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We got together uhm, me and him and Billy Higgins, we hooked up and started playing in a little place called The Angry Squire, and the guy loved us there. Man, we could play anytime we feel like it you know, we used to get mad and quit and go back, you know.
You know, but it was one of those, you remember The Angry Squire used to have us play in the window?

So we got mad and told the dude, 'man why don't you take us out of this window man,' so he built, so he built the bandstand in the back And I did some things with Bobby Timmons too, we did at Boomer's before Boomer's used to have drummers or drums, we used to do duo in that place on the floor before they had the bandstand.
By the posts there, then, Boomer's used to have you in the window too, you remember?
Yeah, had us in the window too, at this place.
So we used to ask, we used to tell Bob Cooper, said man, get us out of this window, so he moved us back in the back.
Oh wait, I do remember that, yeah I remember.
On the back on the floor, and then finally he said, he was gonna build us a bandstand.
And he did. He built a bandstand back there in the corner.
